jsonTools.label: Workflow Creator

catalog.title: WORKFLOW CREATOR
catalog.desc: Multi-step AI legal workflows — NDA reviews, pre-signoff checklists, redline triage, renewal scanners, and custom workflows you author yourself.
catalog.hoverTip: Run multi-step AI workflows on the doc (admin alpha)

engine.getStarterWorkflows:
function getStarterWorkflows() {
  return [
    {
      id: "nda_quick_review",
      name: "NDA Quick Review",
      icon: "🛡️",
      description: "Extract key NDA terms — duration, governing law, IP, perpetual obligations — into a one-page review table.",
      agreementTypes: ["NDA", "CDA", "Confidentiality Agreement", "Non-Disclosure Agreement"],
      tags: ["review", "extract"],
      steps: [
        { id: "term", type: "ask_ai", name: "Extract term",
          prompt: "What is the term/duration of this NDA? Return JSON with: years (number, 0 if perpetual), perpetual (boolean), notes (string with the exact clause language).",
          schema: { years: "number", perpetual: "boolean", notes: "string" } },
        { id: "law", type: "ask_ai", name: "Extract governing law",
          prompt: "What is the governing law? Return JSON with: jurisdiction (string), venue (string), notes (string with the clause).",
          schema: { jurisdiction: "string", venue: "string", notes: "string" } },
        { id: "ip", type: "ask_ai", name: "Extract IP ownership",
          prompt: "How does this NDA treat IP / pre-existing IP / improvements? Return JSON with: pre_existing_protected (boolean), improvements_owned_by (string: 'discloser' | 'recipient' | 'unclear' | 'shared'), notes (string).",
          schema: { pre_existing_protected: "boolean", improvements_owned_by: "string", notes: "string" } },
        { id: "scope", type: "ask_ai", name: "Confidentiality scope",
          prompt: "What information is covered as 'Confidential Information'? Return JSON with: scope (string, one-sentence summary), carveouts (array of strings — common carveouts the NDA lists), notes (string).",
          schema: { scope: "string", carveouts: "array", notes: "string" } },
        { id: "return_destroy", type: "ask_ai", name: "Return/destroy obligation",
          prompt: "Does the NDA require return or destruction of confidential information at end of term? Return JSON with: required (boolean), method (string: 'return' | 'destroy' | 'either' | 'unclear'), retention_carveout (boolean, whether retention for compliance/backup is allowed), notes (string).",
          schema: { required: "boolean", method: "string", retention_carveout: "boolean", notes: "string" } },
      ],
      report: {
        title: "NDA Quick Review",
        sections: [
          { label: "Term", value: "{{term.years}} years{{term.perpetual ?  · perpetual obligations :}}", note: "{{term.notes}}" },
          { label: "Governing Law", value: "{{law.jurisdiction}}{{law.venue ?  ({{law.venue}}) :}}", note: "{{law.notes}}" },
          { label: "Pre-existing IP", value: "{{ip.pre_existing_protected ? Protected : Not explicitly protected}}", note: "{{ip.notes}}" },
          { label: "Improvements Owned By", value: "{{ip.improvements_owned_by}}", note: "" },
          { label: "Confidentiality Scope", value: "{{scope.scope}}", note: "Carve-outs: {{scope.carveouts}}" },
          { label: "Return / Destroy", value: "{{return_destroy.method}}{{return_destroy.retention_carveout ?  · retention carveout :}}", note: "{{return_destroy.notes}}" },
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      id: "pre_signoff_checklist",
      name: "Pre-Signoff Checklist",
      icon: "✅",
      description: "Sanity-check before a contract goes out: OARS attached? Comments resolved? Track changes accepted? Signature plan?",
      tags: ["review", "signoff", "checklist"],
      steps: [
        { id: "redlines_check", type: "read_doc", name: "Pending tracked changes", field: "hasRedlines" },
        { id: "comments_check", type: "read_doc", name: "Open comments", field: "commentCount" },
        { id: "signature_block", type: "ask_ai", name: "Signature block present?",
          prompt: "Does this document have a signature block at the end with party names, signer titles, and date lines? Return JSON with: present (boolean), party_count (number), missing_fields (array of strings — anything missing like 'date', 'title', 'company name'), notes (string).",
          schema: { present: "boolean", party_count: "number", missing_fields: "array", notes: "string" } },
        { id: "blanks", type: "ask_ai", name: "Outstanding blanks / placeholders",
          prompt: "Are there any unfilled placeholders, blanks, TBD, [bracketed text], or obviously incomplete sections in this document? Return JSON with: count (number), items (array of strings — each one quoted snippet), notes (string).",
          schema: { count: "number", items: "array", notes: "string" } },
        { id: "exec_summary", type: "ask_ai", name: "One-line readiness check",
          prompt: "In ONE sentence, is this document ready for signature? Consider tracked changes pending, open comments, blanks, signature block. Be honest. Return JSON with: ready (boolean), reason (string).",
          schema: { ready: "boolean", reason: "string" } },
      ],
      report: {
        title: "Pre-Signoff Checklist",
        sections: [
          { label: "Ready for signature?", value: "{{exec_summary.ready ? ✓ Yes : ⚠ Not yet}}", note: "{{exec_summary.reason}}", emphasis: true },
          { label: "Pending tracked changes", value: "{{redlines_check.hasRedlines ? Yes — accept/reject pending : None}}", note: "" },
          { label: "Comments in document", value: "{{comments_check.commentCount}} comment(s)", note: "Resolve or remove before signature" },
          { label: "Signature block", value: "{{signature_block.present ? Present : Missing}}", note: "{{signature_block.notes}}" },
          { label: "Outstanding blanks", value: "{{blanks.count}} found", note: "{{blanks.notes}}" },
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      id: "redline_triage",
      name: "Redline Triage",
      icon: "🚦",
      description: "Classify counterparty's tracked changes by severity (low / medium / high) with a one-line rationale each. Built for negotiation prep.",
      tags: ["redlines", "negotiation", "review"],
      steps: [
        { id: "redlines_check", type: "read_doc", name: "Verify tracked changes exist", field: "hasRedlines" },
        { id: "triage", type: "ask_ai", name: "Classify each redline",
          prompt: "This document has tracked changes (marked inline as [INSERTED by Author on YYYY-MM-DD: text] / [DELETED by Author...]). For each redline, classify severity and provide rationale. Return JSON with: changes (array of {snippet (short), author (string), severity ('low'|'medium'|'high'), category (string: 'commercial', 'risk', 'legal', 'cosmetic'), rationale (one sentence)}), summary (string: one-paragraph overall assessment).",
          schema: { changes: "array", summary: "string" } },
      ],
      report: {
        title: "Redline Triage",
        sections: [
          { label: "Overall Assessment", value: "{{triage.summary}}", note: "", emphasis: true },
        ],
        listFromStep: { stepId: "triage", arrayField: "changes", itemTemplate: {
          severityField: "severity",
          titleField: "snippet",
          metaField: "author",
          badgeField: "category",
          bodyField: "rationale",
        }},
      },
    },
    {
      id: "renewal_scanner",
      name: "Renewal Scanner",
      icon: "🔁",
      description: "Find auto-renewal clauses, notice periods, and termination windows. Outputs an action-date calendar for diary entries.",
      tags: ["dates", "renewal", "termination"],
      steps: [
        { id: "renewal", type: "ask_ai", name: "Find auto-renewal language",
          prompt: "Does this contract auto-renew? If so, find the auto-renewal clause and the termination notice period required to prevent renewal. Return JSON with: auto_renews (boolean), renewal_term (string), notice_required_days (number, 0 if none), notice_clause (string with the exact clause language), notes (string).",
          schema: { auto_renews: "boolean", renewal_term: "string", notice_required_days: "number", notice_clause: "string", notes: "string" } },
        { id: "termination", type: "ask_ai", name: "Termination rights",
          prompt: "What are the termination rights in this contract? Return JSON with: for_convenience_days (number, 0 if none), for_cause_days (number), termination_rights (string — one-paragraph summary of how either party can exit), notes (string).",
          schema: { for_convenience_days: "number", for_cause_days: "number", termination_rights: "string", notes: "string" } },
        { id: "key_dates", type: "ask_ai", name: "Action dates",
          prompt: "Based on the renewal and termination provisions, what calendar dates (or relative dates like 'effective_date + N days') should the contract owner diary? Return JSON with: dates (array of {label (string), trigger (string: e.g. 'effective_date + 305 days'), action (string: what to do)}), notes (string).",
          schema: { dates: "array", notes: "string" } },
      ],
      report: {
        title: "Renewal & Termination Map",
        sections: [
          { label: "Auto-renews?", value: "{{renewal.auto_renews ? Yes : No}}", note: "{{renewal.notes}}", emphasis: true },
          { label: "Renewal term", value: "{{renewal.renewal_term}}", note: "" },
          { label: "Notice required", value: "{{renewal.notice_required_days}} days before renewal", note: "{{renewal.notice_clause}}" },
          { label: "Termination for convenience", value: "{{termination.for_convenience_days}} days notice", note: "" },
          { label: "Termination for cause", value: "{{termination.for_cause_days}} days notice", note: "" },
          { label: "Termination rights", value: "{{termination.termination_rights}}", note: "" },
        ],
        listFromStep: { stepId: "key_dates", arrayField: "dates", itemTemplate: {
          titleField: "label",
          metaField: "trigger",
          bodyField: "action",
        }},
      },
    },
    {
      id: "privacy_pii_scan",
      name: "Privacy / PII Scan",
      icon: "🔐",
      description: "Find data-protection clauses, PII references, retention rules, and data-sharing/transfer provisions for fast privacy review.",
      tags: ["privacy", "data", "GDPR", "PII"],
      steps: [
        { id: "pii_refs", type: "ask_ai", name: "PII references",
          prompt: "Find every reference to personal information, personal data, PII, customer data, or employee data in this contract. Return JSON with: count (number), references (array of {snippet (string, quoted), section (string)}), categories (array of strings — types of data mentioned, e.g. 'employee names', 'IP addresses', 'health data').",
          schema: { count: "number", references: "array", categories: "array" } },
        { id: "data_sharing", type: "ask_ai", name: "Data sharing & sub-processors",
          prompt: "Does this contract permit the counterparty to share, transfer, or use sub-processors for data processing? Return JSON with: sharing_allowed (boolean), sub_processors_allowed (boolean), restrictions (array of strings — any restrictions placed on sharing/transfers), cross_border (boolean: are cross-border transfers permitted), notes (string).",
          schema: { sharing_allowed: "boolean", sub_processors_allowed: "boolean", restrictions: "array", cross_border: "boolean", notes: "string" } },
        { id: "retention", type: "ask_ai", name: "Retention & deletion",
          prompt: "What does this contract say about data retention and deletion at end of term? Return JSON with: deletion_required (boolean), retention_period (string, e.g. 'as required by law', '90 days'), backup_carveout (boolean), notes (string).",
          schema: { deletion_required: "boolean", retention_period: "string", backup_carveout: "boolean", notes: "string" } },
        { id: "verdict", type: "ask_ai", name: "Privacy verdict",
          prompt: "Based on the privacy provisions in this contract, rate the privacy posture for Colgate. Return JSON with: rating ('strong' | 'standard' | 'weak'), top_concern (string, one sentence), recommendation (string, one sentence).",
          schema: { rating: "string", top_concern: "string", recommendation: "string" } },
      ],
      report: {
        title: "Privacy / PII Scan",
        sections: [
          { label: "Privacy posture", value: "{{verdict.rating}}", note: "{{verdict.top_concern}}", emphasis: true },
          { label: "Recommendation", value: "{{verdict.recommendation}}", note: "" },
          { label: "PII references found", value: "{{pii_refs.count}} mention(s)", note: "Categories: {{pii_refs.categories}}" },
          { label: "Data sharing allowed?", value: "{{data_sharing.sharing_allowed ? Yes : No}}", note: "Sub-processors: {{data_sharing.sub_processors_allowed ? allowed : not allowed}}" },
          { label: "Cross-border transfers", value: "{{data_sharing.cross_border ? Permitted : Restricted}}", note: "{{data_sharing.notes}}" },
          { label: "Retention", value: "{{retention.retention_period}}", note: "{{retention.deletion_required ? Deletion required at term end : No deletion obligation}}" },
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      id: "defined_terms_map",
      name: "Defined Terms Map",
      icon: "📖",
      description: "Extract every capitalized defined term and its definition into a glossary. Catches misdefined / undefined / circular terms.",
      tags: ["definitions", "drafting", "review"],
      steps: [
        { id: "terms", type: "ask_ai", name: "Extract defined terms",
          prompt: "Extract every capitalized DEFINED TERM in this contract and its definition. Look for terms in quotes/bold/italics, terms defined parenthetically, terms in a Definitions section. Return JSON with: terms (array of {term (string), definition (string, one-sentence), location (string: 'Definitions section' | 'Section X' | 'parenthetical' | 'inline'), used_count (number, how many times the term appears in the doc)}), summary (string).",
          schema: { terms: "array", summary: "string" } },
        { id: "issues", type: "ask_ai", name: "Issue scan",
          prompt: "Looking at the defined terms in this contract, identify any of: (a) terms used but never defined, (b) terms defined but never used, (c) circular definitions, (d) inconsistent capitalization. Return JSON with: undefined_used (array of strings), defined_unused (array of strings), circular (array of strings), inconsistent (array of strings), notes (string).",
          schema: { undefined_used: "array", defined_unused: "array", circular: "array", inconsistent: "array", notes: "string" } },
      ],
      report: {
        title: "Defined Terms Map",
        sections: [
          { label: "Summary", value: "{{terms.summary}}", note: "", emphasis: true },
          { label: "Undefined but used", value: "{{issues.undefined_used}}", note: "These appear capitalized in the doc but have no definition" },
          { label: "Defined but unused", value: "{{issues.defined_unused}}", note: "These have definitions but never appear later — orphans" },
          { label: "Circular definitions", value: "{{issues.circular}}", note: "" },
          { label: "Inconsistent capitalization", value: "{{issues.inconsistent}}", note: "" },
        ],
        listFromStep: { stepId: "terms", arrayField: "terms", itemTemplate: {
          titleField: "term",
          metaField: "location",
          badgeField: "used_count",
          bodyField: "definition",
        }},
      },
    },
    {
      id: "risk_surface_summary",
      name: "Risk Surface Summary",
      icon: "⚖️",
      description: "Quick dimensional risk read — liability cap, indemnity scope, governing law, term. One-paragraph exec brief.",
      tags: ["risk", "exec", "summary"],
      steps: [
        { id: "liability", type: "ask_ai", name: "Liability cap",
          prompt: "What is the liability cap in this contract? Return JSON with: cap_amount (string: e.g. 'fees paid in last 12 months', '$5M', 'uncapped'), exceptions (array of strings — typical carveouts: gross negligence, IP infringement, etc), one_sided (boolean: does one party have a cap and the other doesn't), notes (string).",
          schema: { cap_amount: "string", exceptions: "array", one_sided: "boolean", notes: "string" } },
        { id: "indemnity", type: "ask_ai", name: "Indemnification",
          prompt: "How is indemnification structured? Return JSON with: directions (string: 'mutual' | 'colgate_indemnifies' | 'counterparty_indemnifies' | 'neither'), scope (string: one-sentence summary of what's covered), defense_obligation (boolean), notes (string).",
          schema: { directions: "string", scope: "string", defense_obligation: "boolean", notes: "string" } },
        { id: "term_signal", type: "ask_ai", name: "Term signal",
          prompt: "What's the term of this contract? Return JSON with: initial_term (string), auto_renews (boolean), notice_period_days (number), notes (string).",
          schema: { initial_term: "string", auto_renews: "boolean", notice_period_days: "number", notes: "string" } },
        { id: "exec_brief", type: "ask_ai", name: "Exec brief",
          prompt: "Write a 2-3 sentence executive briefing on this contract focused on RISK. Mention liability cap posture, indemnity direction, term, and any one outlier risk. Plain prose, no preamble. Return JSON with: brief (string).",
          schema: { brief: "string" } },
      ],
      report: {
        title: "Risk Surface Summary",
        sections: [
          { label: "Executive Brief", value: "{{exec_brief.brief}}", note: "", emphasis: true },
          { label: "Liability cap", value: "{{liability.cap_amount}}", note: "{{liability.one_sided ? One-sided cap — review : Symmetric}}" },
          { label: "Cap carve-outs", value: "{{liability.exceptions}}", note: "{{liability.notes}}" },
          { label: "Indemnification", value: "{{indemnity.directions}}", note: "{{indemnity.scope}}" },
          { label: "Defense obligation", value: "{{indemnity.defense_obligation ? Required : Not required}}", note: "{{indemnity.notes}}" },
          { label: "Term", value: "{{term_signal.initial_term}}{{term_signal.auto_renews ?  · auto-renews :}}", note: "Notice: {{term_signal.notice_period_days}} days" },
        ],
      },
    },
  ];
}

// ─── runWorkflow — walks steps, threads context, returns results ────
// ALL step handlers + helpers are nested inside because the bundler
// isolates every top-level function. No external references except
// the providers map passed in.
